prompt: Review this change before it merges. The change is the last commit of this checkout, a Rust workspace. Get the diff with `git diff ea20c1caa64574b5364a93ce15782e128ecdcd5b HEAD`. It puts time limits on subprocess calls and guards stdin reads. Review only this checkout at HEAD. Do not build or run tests. Reply with the full review report.

expected.text: A timed out git scan in learn collect returns an empty string, so a timeout looks like a repo with no history and nothing reports it.
git add -A, switch, fetch and worktree add share a 15 second limit, so large repos time out in normal use.
A timed out gh attestation verify is a hard error even in lenient update mode, where other gaps only warn.
